question: The Rourkela Steel Plant was developed with the collaboration of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Germany.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Rourkela Steel Plant** was set-up in **1959** in the **Sundargarh district of Odisha **in collaboration with **Germany.**
 
• The plant receives **coal from Jharia (Jharkhand) and iron-ore from Sundargarh and Kendujhar.**
 
• The first blast furnace, "Parvati", was lit up by Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the then President of India, on February 3, 1959. 
 
• **The Hirakud Project** supplies power for the **electric furnaces **and** water** is obtained from **the Sankh and the Koel rivers.**
 
• The plant receives coal from Jharia (Jharkhand) and iron-ore from Sundargarh and Kendujhar.
